hypothesis: Laboratory mechanisms can remain reproducible without becoming Architecture Canon.
purpose_scope: Test only whether exact reproduction requirements of one accepted bounded laboratory evidence package can remain explicitly profile-specific while the provisional Architecture obligation surface and H11 semantic oracle remain meaning-level and do not elevate those mechanisms into universal Canon.

exact_laboratory_reproduction_manifest.exactness_scope: Repository-resident evidence manifest, ZIP bytes, file inventories, sizes, SHA-256 digests, environment snapshots, metrics, checkpoint identities, and preserved historical-bundle relation are exact laboratory reproduction requirements only.

architecture_obligation_inventory.obligation: Laboratory evidence and profile mechanisms must remain distinguishable from Architecture authority.
A semantic obligation may survive different realization mechanisms; current mechanism identity is not automatically universal meaning.
Historical evidence identity must remain reproducible without retroactively rewriting Architecture history or changing its claimed scope.
Architecture-level falsification or conformance criteria must be expressible at meaning level without requiring current profile bytes solely because historical laboratory reproduction requires them.

mechanism_dependency_graph_schema.forbidden_unqualified_edge: ARCHITECTURE_REQUIRES from an Architecture obligation to a concrete profile mechanism when the only justification is historical laboratory reproduction.

frozen_mechanism_leakage_rubric.LAB_ONLY: Concrete mechanism is mandatory only for exact reproduction of the named historical laboratory artifact and is explicitly non-Canon.
frozen_mechanism_leakage_rubric.PROFILE_SPECIFIC: Concrete mechanism is a valid realization choice for a named implementation profile but is not required by Architecture.
frozen_mechanism_leakage_rubric.MEANING_LEVEL_JUSTIFIED: A requirement is stated independently of a concrete mechanism; one or more mechanisms may realize it.
frozen_mechanism_leakage_rubric.UNJUSTIFIED_CANON_DEPENDENCY: A concrete laboratory/profile mechanism is made mandatory for Architecture solely because the historical laboratory/evidence package depends on it.
frozen_mechanism_leakage_rubric.support_threshold: mandatory_profile_leakage_count == 0 and all Architecture obligations remain testable/falsifiable without current profile bytes as mandatory semantic-oracle input.

externally_visible_observables: architecture obligation inventory and source references
equivalence_predicate: The historical C5/ADR-0023 evidence package reproduces exactly under its own versioned laboratory manifest, while every H11 Architecture obligation remains expressible and falsifiable without elevating Python, SQL, JSON, ZIP, SHA-256, Event, reducer, Receipt, current clocks/sequences, current report schemas, or other profile-specific machinery into universal Architecture solely because that exact laboratory reproduction requires it.
allowed_losses: No byte, digest, inventory, checkpoint-identity, environment-snapshot, or metric loss is allowed when verifying the named immutable historical evidence bundle.
Architecture-level conformance exercises may use different concrete mechanisms when they preserve the declared meaning-level obligation and explicitly declare any permitted loss.
Profile-specific diagnostic metadata may remain outside Architecture authority.
failure_conditions: The historical evidence package cannot be verified against its frozen manifest without modifying historical evidence bytes or identities.

An Architecture obligation is normatively coupled to Python, PostgreSQL, SQLite, SQL, JSON, ZIP, SHA-256, Event, reducer, Receipt, integer sequence, current report schema, or equivalent profile machinery solely because C5 evidence reproduction requires it.
An Architecture validator or H11 semantic oracle requires current profile bytes/private implementation state where a meaning-level observable would suffice.
A laboratory-only constraint is silently promoted to substrate-neutral Architecture authority.
Historical laboratory reproducibility requires rewriting Architecture history or changing the scope of prior evidence.
The dependency graph omits a known mandatory profile mechanism in a way that hides a Canon dependency.
hard_refutation: Within this preregistered scope, a necessary accepted Architecture obligation cannot remain reproducible/testable unless a profile-specific C5 laboratory mechanism is elevated into universal Architecture solely because historical C5 evidence reproduction depends on that mechanism.
threat_trust_model: circular authority: Architecture cites laboratory evidence and laboratory machinery is then treated as Architecture authority
hidden validator coupling to current bytes, schemas, private state, or implementation-specific helper semantics
same-author self-certification of absence of mechanism leakage
selective omission of a concrete dependency from the mechanism graph
exact-byte laboratory reproducibility conflated with universal semantic conformance
historical evidence or architecture scope rewritten after observing the audit result
reviewer/reproducer independence claimed without a concrete basis

semantic_oracle_authority.oracle: Frozen H11 mechanism-leakage rubric applied to repository-visible Architecture obligations, dependency edges, and external laboratory verification results.
must_not_use_as_semantic_truth: current profile bytes as an Architecture truth source

minimum_qualifying_basis: reviewer/reproducer did not author this H11 preregistration or its frozen leakage rubric
reviewer/reproducer declares the concrete basis for independence from the Architecture/profile mechanism under adjudication
semantic adjudication is made from repository-visible frozen inputs rather than implementation-private state
conflicts, shared custody, shared authorship, or other material dependence are disclosed

reproduction_requirements: checkout/fetch of the frozen repository evidence and Architecture snapshot
verification of the exact C5/ADR-0023 bundle under tools/evidence/verify_bundle.py
preservation of both checkpoint identities and all eight repository-resident ZIP artifacts
complete mechanism dependency graph using the frozen schema
classification of every relevant dependency edge under the frozen leakage rubric
raw dependency/leakage findings before semantic adjudication

adjudication_rules.SUPPORTED_FOR_SCOPE: Exact laboratory bundle verification succeeds; a qualifying independent semantic reviewer/reproducer is established; mandatory_profile_leakage_count is zero; all H11 obligations remain meaning-level/testable without profile-byte promotion; historical evidence and Architecture history remain unchanged.
adjudication_rules.WEAKENED: No hard refutation is observed, but one or more current Architecture statements require narrowing or explicit profile scoping to avoid mechanism capture; the same run cannot rewrite the preregistration or historical evidence to rescue the claim.
adjudication_rules.INDETERMINATE: Evidence, dependency visibility, or qualifying independence is insufficient for semantic adjudication without fabricating certainty.
adjudication_rules.NOT_TESTED: No qualifying execution/adjudication has occurred. This remains the current outcome until a separately admitted execution completes.

explicit_non_targets: new product runtime profile or runtime integration
